Body.Content:
Business value

Technicians often complete work in the field while connectivity is limited or intermittent. When offline changes still need to sync, users and back-office teams can be uncertain whether work details, status updates, and other field changes have reached business systems.

Mobile offline up-sync is being enhanced so changes captured in the field can continue syncing more reliably. This helps frontline users gain confidence that completed work will be submitted without repeatedly checking the app or following up manually.

Feature detail

This update improves mobile offline up-sync for changes created while technicians work in Field Service Mobile. It includes support for background up-sync and user notifications when pending changes still need to sync.

When changes remain pending, the mobile experience can help users understand that additional sync work is still required. The capability is intended to reduce uncertainty around offline changes and help field updates reach Dataverse more reliably as connectivity becomes available.

GA date: November CY2026
